_comment: Reviewed orphan team ids for the search data (#179; docs/data-api.md, 'Search data'). Each entry attaches one (season, teamID) that has games but no conference row that season (TGS's published table leaves it out) to the squad named by its first row ('squad'), as an alias id ('x' in core.json), so head to head and search find its games. A reviewed list with evidence per id, approved by the owner in a PR, never a rule: TGS reuses ids across birth years. search_data.py re-checks every entry on every build (level, regroup, club, birth year, continuity, clash, stale, name, games, evidence); an entry failing any check is left out and reported with every reason, which fails the run and 'python archive.py --search-data --check'. A stale entry (TGS now has the row) is removed by whoever re-crawls that season, in the same PR. A rename needs 'renamed': {from, to, approved}, where approved links the owner's comment.

orphans.name: NCFC Youth ECNL GU13
orphans.evidence: TGS lists 21 games for 45785 in 2020-21 but leaves it out of its conference table (flight 8893 (GU13 ECNL): 12 teams, not 45785). Same id, club 22 (NCFC Youth) and birth year 2008 as the squad's 2021-22 row 'NCFC Youth ECNL GU14'; the name's club part matches every season; no other squad of the club has these birth years with this name.
